verdict.rationale: Whether a voice-agent platform's source is openly licensed is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a hosted proprietary API, plus GitHub starter templates that are sample apps rather than the product's source, with no license stated. Nothing shows the Voice Agent source itself is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
